premises: Plasma nitriding of Ti-6Al-4V at ~500°C for 12h forms a continuous, adherent TiN surface layer.
A TiN surface layer significantly increases surface hardness (30-50% Vickers improvement).
A TiN surface layer significantly enhances wear resistance under ambient sliding contact.
The bulk mechanical properties of the alloy remain largely unaffected by the treatment.
